svg.title: MOSAIC Lab
svg.desc: Minimal MOSAIC wordmark in charcoal and sage with a circular DNA emblem. The DNA is a schematic projection of two right-handed helices with consistent front/back crossings; no tagline.
svg.metadata: {"handedness": "right", "base_pairs_per_turn": 10.5, "axis": "positive z", "camera": "negative y", "projection": "x, -z; nearer depth = -y", "strand_polarity": ["5prime-to-3prime with increasing z", "5prime-to-3prime with decreasing z"], "model": "schematic, not atomic"}
